subject.identity: The extracted ISDone.dll bytes are identical in both setups.

method: Static PE export/import inspection plus objdump disassembly anchored at each export address. Linear disassembly of the whole file misaligns — it swallowed the 55 8b ec prologue of ISDoneStop into the preceding instruction — so every body is decoded starting at its own export address. Each export body is walked depth-first through its branches, and internal calls are followed to depth 4 to reach the Win32 APIs behind the import thunks. The method was calibrated against the already catalogued DLL: it reproduces that build's known result (ISDoneStop reaches DeleteFileA) before being applied to the candidate. Tools in .work/isdone-bb8a0245/.

export_surface.imports: Identical imported DLL set and identical imported function set.
export_surface.note: The three extra extract exports are a wider codec surface, not a different effect model. They matter for the action vocabulary of the plan generator, not for the catalog fields.

structural_comparison.normalisation: Addresses and immediates masked; mnemonic and operand shape compared.

ISDoneInit.nature: register allocation (eax/edx, ebx/esi) plus one early failure branch

external_effect_surface.method: Win32 APIs reachable from each export, following internal calls to depth 4.

global_state_mapping.finding: The DLL-owned state block sits 0x11000 higher than in the reference build.
global_state_mapping.anchor: FileSearchInit writes 0x45DD82 in the reference and 0x46ED82 in the subject.

unmatched_write.finding: One write in the subject's ISDoneInit has no counterpart in the reference. A byte-pattern search of the whole CODE section finds exactly one reference to it — that write. It has no reader, so it cannot change any external effect, the same shape already documented for the FileSearchInit byte in the reference build.

exec2_pointer_slot.subject: 0x46DD20 holds 0x46EDAA
exec2_pointer_slot.note: The arrangement is present but the slot does not follow the 0x11000 shift.

precomp_init_section.basis: PrecompInit is instruction-for-instruction identical to the reference, references the same literals CLS.ini, Precomp, Memory and TempPath, and reaches WritePrivateProfileStringA.

records_deleted_by_isdonestop.basis: ISDoneStop is instruction-for-instruction identical to the reference and reaches DeleteFileA one call deep, with GetFileAttributesA below it, as in the reference.

successful_exports.basis: PrecompInit, FileSearchInit and ChangeLanguage are identical to the reference. ISDoneInit differs only by register allocation and one early failure branch: it writes the same 64 globals and reads the same 70, writes every landmark the reference evidence names, and ends in a single ret with the same Delphi string-cleanup epilogue.

limits: Full DLL API equivalence is not proven; only the exports the catalog depends on were compared.

ISExec and Exec2 differ structurally (92.3% and 89.4%). Their external API surface is identical and the Exec2 result-byte pointer arrangement is present, but the internal write sites of that byte were not re-traced for this build. No catalog field depends on them: resolve_effects settles the silent uninstaller launch from the script's success path, never from the DLL.
No runtime verification. Exec2 pumps Win32 messages through DispatchMessageA, so external window procedure re-entry cannot be excluded statically, exactly as recorded for the reference build.
Static analysis of this exact binary only. A different ISDone.dll build stays uncatalogued and keeps every effect blocked.
